comment: SPEC-016 office dressing layout: layout_office.json plus re-seating. The delivered desk's geometry is replaced by the shared 1.20 x 0.70 m work table, so everything that stood on the old 1.35 x 0.74 m top is re-placed inside the new one (free cells read off rfw_w.scenes.visualization.show_free_surface). The cup's origin is its centre (bounds_min_m z = -0.046), so it rests at 0.796, not at the table top: seating it at 0.752 buried it 46 mm into the table and SUPPORT_TABLE_ORPHANED_ITEM now says so.
